description: An engineer emails about rolling out a mandatory MFA change and only cc's Product. Security and QA — both required by the software policy pack for this topic — are absent from the thread.

trigger.subject: Rolling out mandatory MFA for internal tools next sprint
trigger.body: Heads up — starting next sprint we're enforcing MFA on all internal admin tools. Rolling this out to the auth service this week. Flagging here in case it affects any product timelines.
